scope: FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 Super Time Patroller Uniform and Time Ring of Memories acquisition evidence
verification_policy: Keep the costume and ring as separate inventory categories. Record observed unlock sequences and post-launch issue reports without converting community descriptions into an exact canonical mission trigger unless independently supported.

sources.scope: July 8, 2026 unlock-guide lead specifically covering the Super Time Patroller Suit and Time Ring of Memories.
July 8-10 reports describing the post-story reward cutscene, missing suit/ring cases, and a reported server disconnect during reward delivery.
August 6, 2026 community report describing a fix for a Chapter 4 final-story reward glitch involving the Super Time Patroller Uniform and Time Ring.
Community catalogue independently identifies Super Time Patroller Uniform as a Chapter 4 CAC outfit record.

records.name: Super Time Patroller Uniform
records.chapter_4_association: supported by community catalogue and unlock-guide coverage
records.observed_unlock_evidence: Community reports describe receiving the uniform after the Chapter 4 ending sequence/reward scene.
records.server_or_lobby_dependency: issue reported; exact historical dependency unresolved
records.current_status_after_update: community reports indicate the final-story reward-loss issue was fixed in an August 2026 update, but the exact patch-note wording and technical implementation remain unresolved in this evidence layer

records.name: Time Ring of Memories
records.chapter_4_association: supported by unlock-guide coverage and community reports
records.observed_unlock_evidence: Community reports describe the ring being awarded alongside or in the same final-story reward sequence as the Super Time Patroller Uniform, while some users reported receiving one without the other.
records.server_or_lobby_dependency: issue reported; exact historical dependency unresolved
records.identity_note: Do not count the ring as one of the six Chapter 4 costumes/accessories merely because it appears in the same reward sequence.

issue_timeline.evidence: Unlock guide and community reports begin documenting the Super Time Patroller Uniform and Time Ring of Memories reward sequence.
Players reported missing the uniform and/or ring after completing the DLC story; one report describes losing internet during the reward sequence and returning without the items.
Community update discussion reports that an issue where completing the final story could lose the promised Super Time Patroller Uniform and Time Ring was fixed.

identity_and_count_rules: The Super Time Patroller Uniform is tracked as a costume.
The Time Ring of Memories is tracked separately and is not automatically included in the official six-costume/accessory Chapter 4 count.
A shared reward sequence does not prove that two inventory records have identical acquisition conditions.
A server-error or reward-loss report does not establish a drop rate or hidden requirement.
The existence of an unlock guide is evidence that the reward was discoverable, not by itself proof of the exact mission trigger.
nonclaims: No exact drop rate is inferred.
No Z Rank or Ultimate Finish requirement is inferred.
No exact mission number is inferred for the uniform or ring.
No claim is made that the uniform and ring are always awarded together.
No technical cause for the historical reward-loss bug is asserted.
No internal item ID is inferred.
research_targets: Verify the exact Chapter 4 story mission and completion state that awards the uniform.
Verify the exact acquisition trigger for the Time Ring of Memories separately from the uniform.
Locate official patch notes or equivalent primary evidence for the August 2026 reward-loss fix.
Determine whether the historical issue affected online lobby synchronization, reward delivery, or another subsystem.
Reconcile both records with the six official Chapter 4 costume/accessory count without counting the ring twice.
